'''Donald Anthony Cerrone''' (born March 29, 1983), known professionally by his nickname "'''Cowboy'''", is an American former professional [[mixed martial artist]], former [[kickboxer]], and actor best known for competing in the [[Lightweight (MMA)|Lightweight]] and [[Welterweight (MMA)|Welterweight]] divisions of the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC), and the Lightweight division of the [[World Extreme Cagefighting]] (WEC).<ref>{{cite web|title=Ugh! 'Cowboy' Cerrone was once disemboweled by his ATV|url=https://www.foxsports.com/ufc/story/fighter-donald-cerrone-once-disemboweled-by-atv-121715Cerrone|work=[[Fox Sports]]|access-date=December 3, 2018}}</ref>

He is known and respected by fans for his willingness to fight any time, having completed thirty eight fights in his eleven-year UFC tenure. Cerrone challenged for the [[List of WEC champions#Lightweight Championship|WEC Lightw
